events.title: Woodstock Festival Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Woodstock Music & Art Fair took place over three days in upstate New York, becoming a pivotal moment in music history.

angles.name: Summer of Love Legacy
angles.copy: 57 years ago, half a million people descended on a dairy farm for three days of peace and music. What's your favourite Woodstock moment or performance?

events.title: Elvis Presley's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: The King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, passed away at his Graceland home in Memphis, Tennessee.

angles.name: Remembering The King
angles.copy: Remembering Elvis Presley today. His music continues to define generations and influence artists worldwide. What's your go-to Elvis track?

events.title: Tupac Shakur's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: Hip-hop icon Tupac Shakur was fatally shot in Las Vegas, leaving behind a profound musical legacy.

angles.name: Tupac's Enduring Impact
angles.copy: 30 years since we lost Tupac Shakur. His lyrics and impact on hip-hop culture are still felt today. What's your favourite Tupac track?

events.title: Jimi Hendrix's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix died in London at the age of 27, cementing his place as a rock innovator.

angles.name: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
angles.copy: Remembering the unparalleled talent of Jimi Hendrix today. His revolutionary guitar work continues to inspire. What's your favourite Hendrix riff?

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their eleventh studio album, 'Abbey Road', featuring iconic tracks like 'Come Together' and 'Something'.

angles.name: Abbey Road Legacy
angles.copy: 57 years ago, The Beatles gave us 'Abbey Road'. From the iconic zebra crossing to timeless tracks, what's your favourite thing about this legendary album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Chrissie Hynde, lead singer of The Pretenders, celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Chrissie Hynde
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 75th birthday to the incredible Chrissie Hynde! A true rock icon, what's your favourite Pretenders track?

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday Liam Gallagher
angles.copy: Happy 54th birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher! What's your favourite Oasis anthem or solo track from the man himself?

events.title: John Lennon's Imagine Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic solo album 'Imagine', featuring the timeless title track, 51 years ago.

angles.name: Imagine's Enduring Message
angles.copy: 51 years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. The message of peace and unity in this iconic song resonates as strongly as ever.

events.title: First iPod Release Anniversary
events.blurb: Apple introduced the original iPod, revolutionising portable music players and changing how we listen to music.

angles.name: The iPod Revolution
angles.copy: Remember the original iPod? 25 years ago, Apple changed personal music forever. Did you have one of the early models?

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Global celebrations mark the anniversary of the world premiere of the first James Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Favourite Bond Moment
angles.copy: Happy James Bond Day! From iconic gadgets to unforgettable theme tunes, what's your favourite 007 film or moment?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: The legendary Beatles co-founder and peace activist John Lennon would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Remembering John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon, who would have been 86 today. His music and message continue to inspire generations. What's your favourite Lennon song?

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Actor, comedian, and writer John Cleese, known for Monty Python and Fawlty Towers, celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Happy Birthday John Cleese
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the legendary John Cleese! A true titan of British comedy. What's your favourite Cleese moment?

events.title: The Beatles' White Album Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as 'The White Album', featuring diverse tracks like 'While My Guitar Gently Weeps' and 'Blackbird'.

angles.name: The White Album's Impact
angles.copy: 58 years ago, The Beatles delivered 'The White Album'. A sprawling, experimental masterpiece. What's your standout track from this iconic double LP?

events.title: Freddie Mercury's Passing Anniversary
events.blurb: The iconic Queen frontman Freddie Mercury passed away in London, leaving an indelible mark on music history.

angles.name: Remembering Freddie Mercury
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury today. His voice, stage presence, and legacy are truly immortal. What's your favourite Queen song?
